title: KRAM: Knowledge-driven robust training against label noise for medication recommendation
relevance_note: Closest MedRec label-noise method; co-denoising and label refinement raise the baseline bar.
quality_note: Primary publisher source; noise evaluation uses random replacement/addition rather than a selective prescribing observation model.

title: Debiased medication recommendation through fusing frequent pattern and temporal medical records
relevance_note: Closest collision for long-tail prevalence bias and history-based medication recalibration.

title: Medication mapping and diagnosis enhancement for fine-grained medication recommendation
relevance_note: Direct collision for diagnosis-level supervision and fine-grained recommendation.

title: Real-world evaluation of medication recommendation workflows: Retrieval augmentation, physician-RAG collaborative workflow, and prescribing quality
relevance_note: Expert CORE/ALT/AVOID reference supports non-exhaustive treatment semantics.
quality_note: Problem-boundary evidence, not a method template.

title: SafeRx-Agent: A Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Safe and Explainable Medication Recommendation
relevance_note: Case analysis gives an existence example of a clinically reasonable continuation outside current-visit ground truth.
quality_note: Use as existence evidence only; not prevalence evidence.

title: CEHMR: Curriculum learning enhanced hierarchical multi-label classification for medication recommendation
relevance_note: Strong prior for hierarchical multi-label objectives and curriculum learning.

title: Unbiased Recommender Learning from Missing-Not-At-Random Implicit Feedback
relevance_note: Canonical PU/MNAR implicit-feedback prior art and generic baseline family.

title: Counterfactual Implicit Feedback Modeling
relevance_note: Strong CCF-A collision for joint PU/MNAR counterfactual modeling.

title: Correct and Weight: A Simple Yet Effective Loss for Implicit Feedback Recommendation

quality_note: Current preprint; not relied upon for venue-level claims.
